purpose: Native index template; initializer binds the secondary embedding endpoint, deployment and UAMI and sends only REST index properties.
name: spo-native-index

documentSemantics.snippet: Content Understanding Markdown text section, including inline figure descriptions.
documentSemantics.doc_url: Staged blob metadata_storage_path; not the original SharePoint URL.
documentSemantics.snippet_parent_id: Search-generated parent key; not the Function source_id.
documentSemantics.metadata: Preserve originalURL and other source metadata in staging; do not substitute them for metadata_storage_path in child projections.
documentSemantics.images: Images and locationMetadata are enrichment outputs; no asset-store persistence or KB image serving is requested.
